lead: A `# Known gaps` block that enumerates nothing is *one* item to `owners.py`, whatever its paragraph count.
body: `--untagged` then names only the first paragraph's opening sentence, which reads as though the paragraphs under it were already tagged — they are not, they are the same item, and one `— owner:` line is all the block can carry. Enumerate the block into `*` bullets when its paragraphs need different owners, and put each tag on that item's own last line; `items_of` in `tools/owners.py` is the parser that decides it.
